Name: Festive Fireplaces for Alternative Textures
Author: isari112
Description: It's an AT conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/78681618]Nyctowl's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5042]Festive Fireplaces mod[/url]! It's just a simple mod I made for myself because I wanted some more Christmas decorations in my game. Because the mod itself is quite old, it had no iridium fireplace variation, so I added it, based on the stone and brick variants, so now stone, brick and iridium fireplaces have two versions to choose from! :)
